description: The project owner's drug-law (NDPS) questions, copied VERBATIM from chat on 2026-11-08 (11:27), BEFORE the NDPS Act was added to NyayaAI. Do not edit.
author: project owner
questions: My brother was arrested after the police found drugs in a bag inside a shared apartment in Bengaluru. Several people had access to that room, but the police are blaming him. What legal rights does he have, and how can he challenge the allegation?

The police searched my rented room in Kolkata and seized some suspected narcotic substances. They didn't explain why they were searching the room. What legal safeguards apply during a search and seizure under the NDPS Act?

Someone was arrested in Mumbai with a large quantity of an illegal drug in their car. The police are accusing him of drug trafficking. How does Indian law distinguish small, intermediate and commercial quantities?

The police caught my friend smoking cannabis at a private gathering in Delhi. He wasn't selling anything or carrying a large quantity. Can he still be arrested, and what punishment does the law provide?
I was caught by the police in possession of a small amount of ganja while travelling in Assam. I've never been involved in anything like this before. What legal consequences could I face?
